svg.text: Diffusion: ruin the image first, then learn to repair it step by step
training: add noise (known answer, examples come free)
generation: denoise (start from pure noise, run the learned"image repair"backwards)
each step only has to learn"to remove a little noise"——a far smaller task than"drawing it right first time".
Every noising step is known, so training data can be generated without limit: that is how diffusion learns detail.
